title: StampOrder
description: The Factory contract (0011) — archetype → incarnation stamping at scale, governed. CO's farms generalized. Every stamped incarnation walks through the Gateway (0010): leased, budgeted, surfaced. Trust-tier scale caps (0013 §8) land here as the stamp_quota dial.

generation.description: The cohort label — the draft class. Feeds (scope, generation) roll-ups: compare season-3's class to season-1's (0005).

skills.description: The skill-version pin at birth. Upgrades arrive later via the normal Standards cascade — locked 2026-07-02: incarnations upgrade IN PLACE, memory intact.

budget_tokens.description: Per-incarnation model budget, riding each lease token (0010).

probation_runs.description: Locked 2026-07-02: judge sampling runs at 1.0 until the incarnation's first bundle reaches this n — rookies play under full observation until they have a track record.

BirthCertificate.description: An incarnation's provenance — identity operations are memory too (0006 §4): the certificate is written as a signed record at the stamping scope. born_at is universe-time: the rookie is born in season 3.

order.description: → the StampOrder this birth belongs to.
